tasks.title: Fork UI driver: build it, run it, record the findings
acceptance: C1 launch: after `npm run build` in the worktree, `node .dir-sdlc/handruns/2026-09-30-electron-handrun/driver/run-fork-ui.mjs` (default slug `fork-ui`) launches Electron on `<worktree>/out/main/index.js`. `driven-report-fork-ui.json`'s `meta.mainEnv.USERPROFILE` equals the sandbox home, `meta.mainEnv.userData` begins with `meta.sandboxRoot`, and `meta.mainEnv.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is null. All three are read from the main process, per contract I1 and I2.
C2 real home: `meta.realSettingsSha256.before` equals `meta.realSettingsSha256.after` in `driven-report-fork-ui.json`, the sha256 of the real `~/.claude/settings.json`, or `absent` on both sides.

C3 reuse, not copy: `grep -c "from './sandbox.mjs'" .dir-sdlc/handruns/2026-09-30-electron-handrun/driver/run-fork-ui.mjs` prints 1, and `grep -c 'function buildSandbox' .dir-sdlc/handruns/2026-09-30-electron-handrun/driver/run-fork-ui.mjs` prints 0. Control: the second grep over `driver/sandbox.mjs` prints 1 (`sandbox.mjs:43`).

C4 earlier artifacts byte-identical (preserved by design, checked mechanically). In Git Bash, `H=C:/Users/dmarq/Development/Repos/orcastrate/.claude-worktrees/20261109-1642-fork-ui-human-checks/.dir-sdlc/handruns/2026-09-30-electron-handrun; find "$H" -type f ! -path "$H/screenshots/fork-ui*" ! -iname '*fork-ui*' ! -name README.md | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum` prints `a9edbb25493ff22cc65118e28ae3ea5aa8e1b14b07041b5370cd0ef7ac04c9ca`, and the same `find` piped to `wc -l` prints 80. Both were measured at base fea8246. The 80 agrees with the 81 files that git tracks under that directory less README.md.
C5 state S1 reached by contract I3's route: `states` in `driven-report-fork-ui.json` records S1 `reached: true`, and P1's fork control has `data-eligibility="no-session"`.
C6 state S2 reached by contract I3's route (a `push:podStatus` sent from main): S2 is `reached: true`, P2's fork control has `data-eligibility="mid-turn"`, and its run control has `data-verb="stop"`.

C7 state S3 reached by contract I3's route, with no `claude` process: S3 is `reached: true`. `pods.list` holds a Pod whose `forkedFromPodId` is P3's id and whose `ccSessionId` is neither null nor P3's. The fixture project directory's `.jsonl` count went up by exactly 1 across the click, with both counts recorded. The session-id write route used (1 or 2) is recorded.

C8 state S4 reached by contract I3's route: S4 is `reached: true`. A `role=alert` element's text starts with `forkSession failed for pod ` (the template at `src/main/pod-manager/pod-manager.ts:555`), and the `pods.list` length is the same before and after the click.

C9 O1 (glyph is a fork mark): the O1 row of `FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md`'s verdict table has verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Its Measured cell names the fork-vs-reference and fork-vs-transparent comparison results. The instrument check (U+0379 identical to the U+0378 reference) is recorded, and the Observed cell for the U+0379 substitution control shows the decision reporting a missing glyph, as predicted in contract I4.

C10 O2 (same size as the play and delete glyphs): the O2 row has verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured names the computed font-size and text-range height of all three spans (box height recorded, unscored) plus `devicePixelRatio`. The doubled-font-size control's Observed cell shows 0 of 2 text-range height pairs equal.

C11 O3 (no-session Pod dimmed): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the fork and run control opacities. The control on eligible P3 observed equal opacities (not dimmed).

C12 O4 (no-session Pod not-allowed cursor): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the computed cursor. The P3 control observed `pointer`.

C13 O5 (no-session reason tooltip): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the hovered `title` obtained by hit-testing per contract I4, compared with the text at `src/renderer/src/pods/fork-control.ts:25`. The P3 control observed `null`.
C14 O6 (running Pod dimmed): as C11, measured on P2 in state S2.
C15 O7 (running Pod not-allowed cursor): as C12, measured on P2 in state S2.

C16 O8 (running Pod reason tooltip): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). The hovered `title` on P2 is compared with the text at `fork-control.ts:28`. The P3 control observed `null`.

C17 O9 (fork's tab tooltip `Forked from <parent title>`): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the hovered `title` of the fork's tab and P3's title. The control on P3's own tab observed `null`.

C18 O10 (dismiss on the error text's line): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the number of line boxes in the alert text, and how many of them contain the button's vertical centre. The `flex-direction: column` control observed 0.

C19 O11 (dismiss vertically centred): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the centre-Y difference and the one-device-pixel tolerance, derived from the `devicePixelRatio` read in the window. The `margin-top` control observed a difference of half the button's measured height, within one device pixel.

C20 O12 (dismiss readable, dark preference): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the foreground, the background, and the contrast ratio against 4.5. The colour-equals-background control observed 1.00.

C21 O13 (dismiss readable, light preference): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not), from the same measurement taken under `emulateMedia({ colorScheme: 'light' })`. Measured also states whether foreground and background are identical to O12's. The control observed 1.00.

C22 O14 (visible focus ring on `Dismiss fork error`, reached by Tab only): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the Tab-press count, `:focus-visible`, outline style, width and contrast against 3.0, and whether the painted clip differed from the control's. The `outline:none !important` control observed outline-style `none`.

C23 O15 (Enter closes the alert): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the alert and button counts after Enter. The Shift-key control observed the alert count stay at 1.

C24 O16 (focus ring then on the Pods chrome container): verdict `pass` or `defect`, or `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` on the terms of C25 (in which case the Measured and Observed requirements here apply to whatever was measured, and the observation's `reason` names what was not). Measured gives the `document.activeElement` test id, `:focus-visible`, and the outline style, width and contrast. The mouse-dismiss control observed the chrome focused with `:focus-visible` false.

C25 verdict rule: in `driven-report-fork-ui.json`, no observation has verdict `pass` or `defect` while its `control.fired` is false. Contract I2 makes such an observation `instrument-invalid`. A `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` observation carries a non-null `reason`, and for `not-run` the reason names each I3 route attempted and its error. This is the only route by which an observation in C9-C24 may end other than `pass` or `defect`: `not-run` requires both I3 routes to have been attempted for its state, each with its error recorded in that state's `evidence`.

C26 findings table format: `FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md` has exactly one table whose header is the contract I2 header, with 16 data rows O1–O16 in order. Counted with `python -I`, splitting each row on `|`, every data row has the header's field count. Control: the header line itself yields 9 fields under the same split, 7 cells plus the two empty edges.

C27 findings summary: below the table, `FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md` states the driver's exit code, which must equal `meta.exitCode` and follow contract I1's exit-code table. It also states `devicePixelRatio`, the viewport, and the route per state, and for each backlog row 1-5 whether all of its mapped observations are `pass`.

C28 no pixel literal and null-initialised references (the measurement rule in discussion.md, Context, harness facts): in `run-fork-ui.mjs`, no verdict compares a measurement with a length literal. Every length comparison is between two values measured in the same window, or against the one-device-pixel tolerance read in the window. Every element or measurement reference used by a verdict is declared with `null` as its initial value.

C29 encodes test discipline, Coverage (a test is shown able to fail): each of O1-O16 has a control whose `predicted` was written in the driver before it ran, as a literal or as a rule over the same window's measurements, and the reviewer can see this in `run-fork-ui.mjs`. Controls are in-window only, and no file in the worktree is modified to run one.

C30 outputs confined: no PNG is written outside `H/screenshots/fork-ui/`, which C4's hash verifies for the existing screenshots. `run-fork-ui.mjs` calls neither `writeReport(` nor `shot(` from `lib.mjs`: `grep -cE '\bwriteReport\(|[^a-zA-Z]shot\(' .dir-sdlc/handruns/2026-09-30-electron-handrun/driver/run-fork-ui.mjs` prints 0, or every match is a function the driver defines itself, named in the report.
C31 no session path: `grep -c '\.sir/'` over `run-fork-ui.mjs`, `FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md` and `driven-report-fork-ui.md` prints 0 for each file.

C32 README: `README.md`'s `## Later runs in this directory` list gains one bullet naming `FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md` and the run's headline result, in the form of the existing bullets at README.md:54-62, and no existing line of README.md changes.
C33 sandbox removed: after the run (no `--keep-sandbox`), the directory named by `meta.sandboxRoot` does not exist.

tasks.title: Fix each defect the run found, with a regression test
acceptance: C1 no-defect branch: if no observation in `FINDINGS-FORK-UI.md`'s verdict table has verdict `defect`, this task changes no file, and its report says so and quotes the verdict column. This branch is satisfied at startRef by design, because it is conditional on T1's findings.

C2 one fix per defect: for each observation with verdict `defect`, the report names the observation id, the cause at `file:line` in an owned file, and the change that removes it. No change is made for an observation whose verdict is `pass`, `not-run` or `instrument-invalid` (contract I5).

C3 regression test per fix (encodes test discipline, Coverage: a bug fix arrives with the test that reproduces it): each fixed defect has a test in an owned test file, jsdom first and node-environment stylesheet text second (contract I5). Its report shows that the test can fail, either by a red step (command and failure output before the fix) or by reverting the fix at a named `file:line` with the failing output. Where neither form can express the defect, the report says so for that observation and why.

C4 escalate rather than fix: a defect whose fix needs a file outside this task's `owns`, a token change in `src/renderer/src/styles/tokens.css`, or a product decision (for example a light theme) is reported as an escalation, with no partial fix in owned files (contract I5).

C5 encodes frontend discipline, Accessibility floor (every interactive element reachable by keyboard; focus visible and predictable). No change sets `disabled` on the Fork control (the `aria-disabled` design at `src/renderer/src/pods/PodTab.tsx:341-346`) or removes `Dismiss fork error` or the Pods chrome container from keyboard focus: `grep -cE '^\s+disabled(=|$)' src/renderer/src/pods/PodTab.tsx src/renderer/src/pods/PodsChrome.tsx` prints 0 for each file, as at base fea8246. The predicate was checked at authoring: it matches `DeletePodDialog.tsx:160` (`disabled={submitting || podDeleted}`) and does not match `PodTab.tsx:354` (`aria-disabled=`). Also, `grep -c 'tabIndex={-1}' src/renderer/src/pods/PodsChrome.tsx` still prints 1, as at base, which keeps the chrome container programmatically focusable.

C6 encodes the project frontend fragment (indexed access under `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`): no added line in an owned production file uses a non-null assertion `!` or an `as` cast as a guard for an indexed or destructured value.
C7 scoped suite: if any file changed, `npx vitest run src/renderer/src/pods src/renderer/src/__tests__/pod-fork.e2e.test.tsx` exits 0, and the report gives its file and test counts.

tasks.title: Re-check fixed defects; repo-wide typecheck and tests
acceptance: C1 no-fix branch: if T2 changed no file (the orchestrator states this in the dispatch), this task does not run the driver and writes no file. This is conditional by design.

C2 re-run: otherwise, after `npm run build`, `node .dir-sdlc/handruns/2026-09-30-electron-handrun/driver/run-fork-ui.mjs --slug fork-ui-recheck` writes `driven-report-fork-ui-recheck.json`, and its `meta.driverSha256` equals `meta.driverSha256` in `driven-report-fork-ui.json`, so the driver is the one T1 ran, unchanged.

C3 fixed means re-checked: in `driven-report-fork-ui-recheck.json`, every observation that T2's report names as fixed (contract I5), as the orchestrator lists them in this task's dispatch, has verdict `pass`, and its `control.fired` is true. An observation T2 escalated instead of fixing is not held to this; its verdict is recorded in `FINDINGS-FORK-UI-RECHECK.md` as it stands.
C4 no regression: in `driven-report-fork-ui-recheck.json`, every observation that `driven-report-fork-ui.json` records as `pass` is still `pass`, with `control.fired` true.

C5 recheck findings: `FINDINGS-FORK-UI-RECHECK.md` holds the contract I2 verdict table for the re-run, which meets T1 C26's field-count check, and a line per previously-`defect` observation giving its before and after verdict. `grep -c '\.sir/'` over it prints 0.

C6 earlier artifacts still byte-identical (preserved by design, checked mechanically): T1 C4's hash command prints `a9edbb25493ff22cc65118e28ae3ea5aa8e1b14b07041b5370cd0ef7ac04c9ca`, and its count prints 80, at this task's tip.

C7 DAG tail typecheck (project lesson: vitest does not typecheck): `npm run typecheck` in the worktree exits 0 at this task's tip. No task depends on T3, so no later task can break it. Preserved by design when T2 changed nothing.

C8 DAG tail suite: `npm test` in the worktree exits 0 at this task's tip, with 0 failed files and 0 failed tests, and the report gives the passed file and test counts. Preserved by design when T2 changed nothing.
